idea-plugin.name: Architecture Breadcrumbs
idea-plugin.description:
Stop Losing Architecture Decisions — Pin Them to Your Code

Architecture Breadcrumbs lets you attach architectural notes — decisions, patterns, constraints, TODOs, warnings and context — to specific lines of your code. Breadcrumbs are stored in .arch-breadcrumbs.json at the project root, so they are versioned and shared with your team through git.

Features

  • Add Architecture Breadcrumb — editor popup menu or Ctrl+Shift+B: text, category, author and optional links to other breadcrumbs
  • Gutter icons — one icon per breadcrumb line, with the note as tooltip; can be toggled per category
  • Breadcrumbs tool window — table of all breadcrumbs with category filter and full-text search; double-click to jump to the line
  • Navigate Linked Breadcrumbs — Go To menu: jump to breadcrumbs linked from the one at the caret, or pick from all breadcrumbs
  • Six categories — Decision, Pattern, Constraint, TODO, Warning, Context
  • Works in any file type

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2+ (or any JetBrains IDE on build 242+)

Support

  • Documentation
  • Issue Tracker (GitHub)

action.description: Add an architecture breadcrumb annotation at the current line

idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/architecture-breadcrumbs

What's New

  • 6 Breadcrumb Categories - Annotate code with Decision, Pattern, Constraint, Trade-off, Assumption, and Risk markers
  • Gutter Icons and Inlay Hints - Visual markers in the editor with color-coded backgrounds for each category
  • Breadcrumb Explorer - Dedicated tool window to browse all annotations by category or file
  • Quick Navigation - Jump between related architectural annotations across the project
  • VCS-Friendly Storage - Annotations stored in .arch-breadcrumbs.json for easy team sharing via Git
  • Multi-Language Support - Works with Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Go
  • Architecture Map - Visual overview of your project's architectural structure
  • Export to Diagrams - Generate Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams from your breadcrumbs
